title: Email and password login
description: The system shall authenticate a user against their email and password using a server-side session, rejecting invalid credentials with a non-revealing error message.

title: Remember-me sessions
description: The system shall persist an authenticated session across browser restarts when the user selects the remember option at login.

title: Logout
description: The system shall invalidate the active session and regenerate the session token when the user logs out.

title: Student self-registration
description: The system shall allow a guest to register a student account by supplying student number, name, email, password, college, program, contact number, GWA, family income, address, and privacy consent.

title: Email OTP verification
description: The system shall issue a six-digit one-time passcode by email and require the user to enter it before accessing role-protected pages.

title: OTP resend with cooldown
description: The system shall permit the user to request a replacement passcode only after a configured cooldown, and shall invalidate the previous unconsumed code.

title: Authentication rate limiting
description: The system shall throttle login attempts to five per minute, registrations to three per minute, OTP submissions to ten per minute, and OTP resends to six per minute.

title: Inactive account rejection
description: The system shall deny authentication to an account whose active flag is false and shall terminate any session belonging to a deactivated account.

title: Legacy account verification backfill
description: The system shall treat accounts created before the OTP feature as already email-verified so that administrator-created users are not locked out.

title: Self-service password reset
description: The system should allow a user to reset a forgotten password through an emailed single-use token; only administrator-initiated reset is implemented.

title: Role assignment
description: The system shall assign exactly one role to each user account, drawn from student, counselor, or administrator.

title: Route-level role enforcement
description: The system shall reject requests from an authenticated user whose role does not match the route group prefix with an HTTP 403 response.

title: Panel access gates
description: The system shall expose access-admin-panel, access-counselor-panel, and access-student-panel gates that require both the correct role and an active account.

title: Shared staff gate
description: The system shall expose a manage-enrollment-verifications gate satisfied by an active administrator or an active counselor.

title: Record ownership policies
description: The system shall authorize document, appointment, and notification access through policies that compare the record owner with the authenticated user.

title: Role-aware landing page
description: The system shall redirect an authenticated user from the site root to the dashboard of their role, and return HTTP 403 when no dashboard is configured.

title: Profile creation on registration
description: The system shall create exactly one student profile linked to the user account when a student registers or when an administrator creates a student account.

title: View own profile
description: The system shall display the authenticated student's profile, enrollment status, and enrollment verification history.

title: Edit own profile fields
description: The system shall allow a student to edit contact number, address, GWA, and family income only, and shall reject attempts to change student number, name, year level, college, program, and enrollment status.

title: Search student profiles
description: The system shall provide a filtered, paginated list of student profiles searchable by name, student number, college, program, year level, and enrollment status.

title: Maintain student profiles
description: The system shall allow an administrator to view and update any student profile, including administrator-only academic fields.

title: Create user accounts
description: The system shall allow an administrator to create a user account for any role, creating the linked student profile when the role is student.

title: Activate and deactivate accounts
description: The system shall allow an administrator to activate or deactivate a user account without deleting it.

title: Administrator password reset
description: The system shall allow an administrator to set a new password for a user account without knowing the existing password.

title: Set profile passcode
description: The system shall allow a student to set a profile passcode that locks the profile view for the current session.

title: Passcode hashing
description: The system shall store the profile passcode only as a one-way hash and shall never render or transmit the plaintext value.

title: Lock and unlock own profile
description: The system shall allow a student to lock or unlock the profile within the current session using the passcode, throttling unlock attempts.

title: Administrator passcode recovery
description: The system shall allow an administrator to unlock a student profile session lock and to reset a forgotten passcode.

title: Per-term verification records
description: The system shall store enrollment verification decisions as discrete records scoped to an academic year and semester for a student profile.

title: Verification request intake
description: The system should provide a route through which a student's verification request for the current term is created and queued for staff review.

title: Record verification decision
description: The system shall allow an authorized staff member to record verified, rejected, or unable-to-verify, requiring a reason for the latter two, and shall update the student profile enrollment status accordingly.

title: Current-term scoping
description: The system shall read the current academic year and semester from configuration and treat verification for any other term as insufficient.

title: Enrollment-gated services
description: The system shall block application submission, document upload, appointment booking, and service request submission until the student's enrollment is verified for the current term.

title: Legacy account exemption
description: The system shall grant enrollment-gated access to students who have no verification records at all, preserving pre-existing access until the first record is created.

title: Create scholarship
description: The system shall allow an administrator to create a scholarship with title, description, provider, type, eligibility thresholds, eligible programs, eligible year levels, required enrollment status, and application window.

title: Edit scholarship
description: The system shall allow an administrator to update any scholarship attribute while preserving its identifier and applications.

title: Scholarship status lifecycle
description: The system shall restrict scholarship status to draft, open, closed, or archived.

title: Activate and deactivate scholarship
description: The system shall allow an administrator to move a scholarship between open and closed with a single action.

title: Manage requirements
description: The system shall allow an administrator to add, edit, reorder, mark optional, and delete the document requirements of a scholarship.

title: Browse open scholarships
description: The system shall list only scholarships whose status is open and whose application window contains the current date to students.

title: Filter and sort scholarships
description: The system shall allow a student to filter scholarships by type, provider, program, and eligibility, and to sort by deadline, name, newest, or match score.

title: Scholarship announcement
description: The system shall allow an administrator to broadcast an announcement notification to students who are currently eligible for a scholarship.

title: View scholarship detail
description: The system shall display the full scholarship record, its requirements, and the student's existing application state, returning not-found for scholarships that are not open.

title: Evaluate eligibility criteria
description: The system shall evaluate a student profile against a scholarship on GWA, family income, program, year level, and enrollment status, producing met, not-met, or not-applicable for each criterion.

title: Explain criterion outcomes
description: The system shall present each criterion outcome with the compared values and a human-readable reason so that the student understands the decision.

title: Determine overall eligibility
description: The system shall return an overall eligible or not-eligible decision derived from all criteria and shall attach a summary reason.

title: Eligibility preview page
description: The system shall provide a per-scholarship eligibility preview for the signed-in student without creating an application.

title: Compute weighted match score
description: The system shall compute a match score for a student-scholarship pair from academic, financial, program, year-level, and document-readiness factors using the active weights.

title: Configure matching weights
description: The system shall allow an administrator to view and update the five matching weights.

title: Validate weight total
description: The system shall reject a weight configuration whose five values do not total exactly 100.

title: Categorize recommendations
description: The system shall classify each scholarship as eligible recommendation, potential match, or not eligible.

title: Student recommendations view
description: The system shall present ranked scholarship recommendations and a full match list to the signed-in student.

title: Document-readiness factor
description: The system shall include the proportion of required documents already uploaded when scoring a match.

title: Create draft application
description: The system shall create a draft scholarship application for the signed-in student when the student starts an application.

title: Generate application number
description: The system shall assign a unique human-readable application number to every application, retrying on collision.

title: Prevent duplicate applications
description: The system shall permit at most one application per student per scholarship for the lifetime of the record.

title: Submit application
description: The system shall allow a student to submit a draft application, stamping the submission time and moving the record into the review workflow.

title: Upload while draft
description: The system shall accept document uploads only while the application is in draft status.

title: Review queue
description: The system shall provide an administrator a searchable, filterable, paginated queue of all applications with student, scholarship, status, and submission date.

title: Perform workflow transition
description: The system shall apply only transitions permitted by the application state machine and shall reject any other transition with a validation error.

title: Approval readiness guard
description: The system shall refuse to approve an application unless every required requirement has an uploaded document in verified status.

title: Application status history
description: The system shall record every status change with previous status, new status, actor, remarks, and timestamp, and display it as a timeline.

title: Notify on application events
description: The system shall notify the student when an application is submitted, placed under review, moved to document verification, approved, or rejected.

title: Withdraw application
description: The system should allow a student to withdraw a submitted application; the status value is reserved but no transition is implemented.

title: Upload document with validation
description: The system shall accept only PDF, JPG, JPEG, or PNG files up to 5 MB for each scholarship requirement.

title: Remove own document
description: The system shall allow a student to delete a document they uploaded while the application is still in draft.

title: Download document
description: The system shall stream a stored document to its owner or to an administrator, and to no other user.

title: Verify or reject document
description: The system shall allow an administrator to mark a document verified or rejected with remarks, recording the verifier and time.

title: Private file storage
description: The system shall store uploaded files on a private disk and expose them only through authorized download routes.

title: Publish weekly availability
description: The system shall allow a counselor to publish availability blocks by day of week and time range, rejecting overlapping blocks.

title: Retire availability block
description: The system shall allow a counselor to deactivate an availability block without deleting its history.

title: Manage appointment types
description: The system shall allow an administrator to create, edit, reorder, and toggle appointment types with an optional duration override.

title: Configure scheduling settings
description: The system shall allow an administrator to set office hours, default duration, minimum booking notice, student cancellation notice, and maximum future booking days.

title: Browse counselors
description: The system shall list counselors who have active availability so a student can choose a counselor.

title: Generate bookable slots
description: The system shall derive bookable slots from counselor availability, office hours, appointment duration, booking notice, and the future booking horizon, excluding slots that conflict with blocking appointments.

title: Book appointment
description: The system shall create an appointment in requested status for the selected counselor, date, slot, type, and reason.

title: Prevent scheduling conflicts
description: The system shall reject a booking that overlaps another blocking appointment for the same counselor or the same student.

title: Confirm reject or complete appointment
description: The system shall allow the assigned counselor to confirm, reject with reason, or complete an appointment in requested or confirmed status respectively.

title: Student cancellation
description: The system shall allow a student to cancel a requested or confirmed appointment that is still outside the cancellation notice window.

title: Administrative oversight
description: The system shall allow an administrator to view all appointments and the details of any appointment without altering its workflow state.

title: Automated reminders
description: The system shall send one in-app and email reminder for each confirmed appointment inside the reminder window, never repeating for the same appointment.

title: Session notes authoring
description: The system should allow counselors to record session notes on an appointment; the fields exist but no authoring interface is implemented.

title: Rescheduling
description: The system should allow a confirmed appointment to be moved to a different slot while preserving its identity.

title: Service catalog
description: The system shall list active service types with their description, instructions, and required attachments.

title: Manage service types
description: The system shall allow an administrator to create, edit, reorder, toggle, and define the requirements of a service type.

title: Submit service request
description: The system shall create a service request from a description of at least ten characters plus optional supporting documents.

title: Generate request number
description: The system shall assign a unique human-readable request number to every service request.

title: Track own requests
description: The system shall list the student's service requests with status, service type, submission date, and handler.

title: Process and assign requests
description: The system shall allow an administrator to assign a request to a handler and to record student-visible and internal remarks.

title: Service request transitions
description: The system shall apply only transitions permitted by the service request state machine and reject all others.

title: Cancel request
description: The system shall allow a student to cancel their own request while it is not in a terminal status.

title: Upload additional documents
description: The system shall allow a student to add supporting documents to an existing non-terminal request.

title: Counselor request handling
description: The system should allow a counselor to view and process service requests assigned to them; no counselor route exists.

title: Create in-app notification
description: The system shall create a notification record for each user-facing event with type, title, message, related record, and metadata.

title: Suppress duplicate notifications
description: The system shall not create a second unread notification of the same type for the same related record and user.

title: Queue email delivery
description: The system shall queue a notification email when the originating event requires email, and shall mark the notification as emailed exactly once.

title: Notification center
description: The system shall list the signed-in user's notifications with category, read state, related reference, and a safe action link.

title: Mark read
description: The system shall allow the user to mark a single notification or all notifications as read.

title: Unread counter
description: The system shall display the count of unread notifications in the top bar and sidebar for the signed-in user.

title: Operational summary metrics
description: The system shall display summary counts of students, scholarships, applications, appointments, and service requests on the administrator dashboard.

title: Scholarship analytics
description: The system shall report application volume and outcomes by scholarship, provider, and status for a selected period.

title: Guidance analytics
description: The system shall report appointment volume by type, counselor, and status for a selected period.

title: Student services analytics
description: The system shall report service request volume by service type and status for a selected period.

title: Period filtering
description: The system shall filter every analytics view by an optional start date and end date and shall validate the supplied range.

title: CSV export
description: The system shall stream the filtered analytics dataset as a CSV download for offline reporting.

title: Log authentication events
description: The system shall record login, failed login, and logout events with actor, address, and user agent.

title: Log business actions
description: The system shall record administrative and workflow actions with module, record type, record identifier, actor, and description.

title: Search and filter audit log
description: The system shall allow an administrator to search and filter audit entries by user, module, action, record type, and date range.

title: View audit entry detail
description: The system shall display the full detail of a single audit entry including request metadata.

title: Audit immutability
description: The system shall expose the audit log as read-only; no update or delete route shall exist.

title: Role-scoped live search
description: The system shall provide typeahead suggestions scoped to the records the signed-in role is allowed to see.

title: Scholarship search service
description: The system shall provide scholarship search with normalized input, allowed sort keys, and eligibility filtering.

title: Input normalization and bounds
description: The system shall normalize search terms by trimming, collapsing whitespace, and bounding length before querying.

title: Page response time
description: Ninety-five percent of authenticated page requests shall complete within two seconds on the reference hardware with the seeded dataset.

title: Indexed query paths
description: Frequent filters and sorts shall be supported by database indexes on status, dates, owner identifiers, and composite application and appointment keys.

title: Pagination
description: Every list view shall paginate results rather than loading complete tables.

title: Asynchronous email
description: Email delivery shall be queued so that no user-facing request waits on the mail transport.

title: Password hashing
description: All passwords and profile passcodes shall be stored using a one-way hash and never in plaintext.

title: Session protection
description: Sessions shall use server-side storage, CSRF tokens on state-changing requests, and session regeneration on authentication.

title: Authorization on every route
description: Every non-public route shall require authentication, and every role-restricted route shall enforce its role or gate server-side.

title: Private document storage
description: Uploaded documents shall not be web-accessible by direct path and shall be served only through policy-checked download routes.

title: Sensitive data exposure
description: Passcode hashes and password fields shall be excluded from serialization and from every rendered view.

title: Upload validation
description: File uploads shall be validated by MIME type and size on the server before storage.

title: Throttling of sensitive actions
description: Login, registration, OTP submission, OTP resend, and profile unlock shall be rate limited per client.

title: Auditability of privileged actions
description: Every privileged state change shall produce an audit entry identifying the actor and the affected record.

title: Consistent navigation
description: Every authenticated page shall present the same persistent sidebar and top bar, with role-appropriate entries only.

title: Inline validation feedback
description: Forms shall display field-level validation messages adjacent to the offending input and preserve previously entered values.

title: Explicit empty states
description: Every list and chart shall display a descriptive empty state instead of a blank region when no data exists.

title: Destructive action confirmation
description: Any destructive or irreversible action shall require an explicit confirmation step.

title: Status legibility
description: Every workflow status shall be rendered with a consistent labeled badge and colour rather than a raw database value.

title: Print support
description: Report and detail pages shall remain legible when printed, suppressing navigation chrome.

title: Transactional integrity
description: Multi-record operations shall execute inside a database transaction so that a partial workflow change cannot persist.

title: Notification idempotency
description: Reminder and email jobs shall use idempotency stamps so that retries cannot duplicate outbound messages.

title: Workflow transition safety
description: An invalid state transition shall be rejected without modifying the record and shall surface a user-readable error.

title: Referential integrity
description: Foreign keys shall enforce ownership between users, profiles, applications, appointments, and requests, with restrictive or cascading behaviour matching business intent.

title: Layered separation
description: Presentation, request validation, business rules, and persistence shall remain separated into Blade, FormRequest, Service, and Eloquent layers.

title: Single source of status values
description: Status values shall be defined once as class constants or enums and reused by services, badges, and filters.

title: Reusable view components
description: Recurring interface elements shall be implemented as Blade components rather than duplicated markup.

title: Configuration-driven term
description: The current academic year and semester shall be supplied by configuration, not hard-coded values.

title: Browser support
description: The system shall operate on current versions of Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari.

title: Server platform
description: The system shall run on PHP 8.2 or later with a MariaDB or MySQL database and a standard Apache or Nginx web server.

title: No client build step
description: The delivered interface shall be usable without a JavaScript bundler, relying on a single stylesheet and a single script.

title: Responsive layout
description: The interface shall remain usable from 360 px through 1920 px, collapsing the sidebar into a drawer below 1024 px.

title: No proprietary runtime
description: The system shall not require a commercial runtime or licence to operate.

title: Environment configuration
description: Database, mail, and academic-term settings shall be supplied through environment configuration rather than source edits.

title: Semantic landmarks
description: Every page shall expose a main landmark, a skip link, and labelled navigation regions.

title: Keyboard operability
description: All interactive controls shall be reachable and operable by keyboard with a visible focus indicator.

title: Status announcement
description: Status and alert regions shall be announced to assistive technology through appropriate roles.

title: Colour contrast
description: Text and interactive elements shall meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast against their backgrounds.

title: Reduced motion
description: Animation shall be suppressed when the user requests reduced motion.

title: Retention of workflow history
description: Status history, audit entries, and verification records shall be retained and never overwritten by later transitions.

title: Consistent timestamps
description: All records shall store created and updated timestamps in server time and render them in a consistent human-readable format.

title: Unique business identifiers
description: Application numbers and request numbers shall be unique and stable for the life of the record.
